summary: Tested MOD attachment thumbnail rendering on dashboard FaultCard and escalation email. All backend edge cases pass (non-existent paths gracefully skipped, empty attachments omit header, real attachments produce base64 data URIs). Frontend correctly renders attachment strip with proper data-testid attributes and viewer URLs. Cross-site security regression verified (army-catterick → 403 for RAF attachment).
seed_data_creation: Created one test fault MOD-2026-19146 with attachment_urls for regression testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: MOD attachment thumbnail rendering fully tested. Key findings: (1) _inline_attachment_block gracefully handles non-existent paths (returns empty, no exception), (2) Empty attachment_urls correctly omits 'Attachments' header in email, (3) Real attachments produce base64 data:image/ URIs in escalation email (~5KB HTML), (4) FaultCard renders attachment strip with data-testid='mod-fault-attachments-{id}' and links with data-testid='mod-fault-{id}-attach-{n}', (5) Cross-site security working (army user gets 403 for RAF attachment).
